author: Rosa Martinez Gaugler
text: You may want to download another app to feed your results to. Gluroo allows you to enter your meals/snacks as well as showing you the results shared from your Libre. I like it partially because the graph is bigger, so doesn't make your day look like wild swings up and down unless they are. The libre's graph is pretty compact, showing almost 12 hrs at a time. The gluroo app let's me adjust the graph to 3 -6 hours at a time, so that a 100 to 120 change doesn't look like you went on a bender. I'm on meds and gluroo allows me to enter and track all of it easily.
